## ✍️ Blog Post Checklist (For Blog PRs)

- [ ] Folder is created under `public/blog/<slug>/` (kebab-case name)
- [ ] `index.md` contains valid and complete frontmatter metadata
- [ ] `coverImage` and `authorImage` specify **filenames only** (not full paths)
- [ ] The author image and cover image files exist inside the post's own folder
- [ ] Verified that the project builds locally (`pnpm build`) without validation errors
